detail.longDescription: Working with AI is getting weird. Two years ago, I used to do most tasks by myself and then jump into a chatbot task to solve a problem four or five times per hour. These days, I end up staring at my screen while my agents do my research, tear down my drafts, or fix up formatting—mostly to make sure they're not going off-task. Is that what we're supposed to be, now? Glorified babysitters to thinking machines? Grok Bot is SpaceX Super Intelligence's solution to this problem. Instead of a chatbot
